title: 8-round AES round structure: Maximum expected differential deviation

target.description: 8 iterated AES rounds on 128-bit blocks in the source's independent-round-key model. The source analyzes 3.5-round structure by omitting the final invertible linear layer when proving its four-round norm bounds. Variant references identify the corresponding round structures/boundaries, not use of the standard master-key schedule.

setting.key_relation: One complete cipher key is a tuple of independently uniformly sampled 128-bit round keys, including the independent input key mask. It is not derived by the AES-128, AES-192 or AES-256 master-key schedule.
setting.key_population: Uniform independent-round-key ensemble for the AES 128-bit round structure; bounds average over the tuple of round keys, not over standard AES master keys.
setting.plaintext_model: For differential statements, any prescribed nonzero input/output difference and the source DDT averaging over input u; the independent input key mask makes averaging over the keys alone equivalent. For pairwise independence, any pair of distinct fixed plaintexts.
assumptions: The categorical single_secret_key denotes one sampled whole round-key tuple, not a standard 128/192/256-bit AES master key; independence is part of the explicit population definition.

Expected differential probability is averaged over the independent round-key ensemble. The paper does not prove the same bounds for every fixed round-key tuple, almost all fixed tuples, or the standard AES key schedule.
The source uses the concrete AES Sbox, ShiftRows and MixColumns, with b=128, k=4 and w=8; generic AES-like auxiliary lemmas are not being promoted to an AES result without its concrete constants.

limitations: Independent-round-key ensemble result, not a fixed-key differential bound or a security theorem for the standard AES key schedule.

The proceedings states these results but sends several proofs, the stronger spectral lemma and evaluation code to ePrint2025/1326; the ePrint PDF route was access-blocked and those omitted details were not independently checked.

property.statement: For every nonzero input/output difference pair in 8-round AES, the expected differential probability lies in 1/(2^128-1) +/- (2^-128/50)*2^(-14.65*(2-2)). This bounds both MEDP and minimum expected differential probability and makes every nonzero differential possible in the averaged model.
property.quantifier: For every prescribed nonzero input/output difference pair, under averaging over independently uniformly sampled round keys; no per-fixed-key quantifier is supplied.
property.scope: Concrete 8-round AES 128-bit round structure. This is a differential (sum of all compatible characteristic probabilities), not a bound on one characteristic. Source Eq(1) is stated for all integers r>=2 at 4r rounds; the stored point uses r=2.
